title: Understanding Sensitivity to Outliers
text: Consider how each error metric, MSE and MAE, responds to large deviations in data points. Which one might amplify the effect of outliers more?

title: Exploring MSE
text: Think about how MSE is calculated. It involves squaring the differences between predicted and actual values. How does squaring affect the influence of larger errors?

title: Exploring MAE
text: MAE calculates the average of the absolute differences between predicted and actual values. How does taking the absolute value affect the influence of larger errors compared to squaring?

title: Comparing MSE and MAE
text: Which error metric is more sensitive to outliers?

hintAnswer: It increases the impact of larger errors.
title: Impact of Squaring in MSE
text: What effect does squaring the differences have on the error metric?
choices: It increases the impact of larger errors.
It decreases the impact of larger errors.
It has no effect on the impact of larger errors.
